title: Gas exchange and oxygenation
objective: Distinguish common terms used to describe breathing and gas exchange.

vocabulary.definition: Subjective difficulty or discomfort in breathing.
vocabulary.example: The patient reported dyspnea on exertion.

vocabulary.definition: An abnormally low level of oxygen in arterial blood.
vocabulary.example: The team monitored the patient for hypoxemia.

vocabulary.definition: The number of breaths taken per minute.
vocabulary.example: The nurse recorded the respiratory rate.

quiz.question: Which term means an abnormally low level of oxygen in arterial blood?
quiz.explanation: Hypoxemia refers to low oxygen in arterial blood.
